paragraphs.text: Aetherborn is a creature type used for cards that depict humanoid creatures made from aether . Some Aetherborn can draw life essence from other beings into themselves to prolong their existence; these have the sub-type vampire .
All aetherborn are black -aligned. They primarily appear in mono- black though Contraband Kingpin is blue-black and Gonti, Uncanny Acquisitor is black-green-blue .

Aetherborn were introduced as a creature type in the Kaladesh block . They came about because the designers didn't want zombies in the world of Avishkar so they was looking for what the main black creature type would be. When examining how each color interacted with aether they came up with the idea of creatures created out of it.
Kaladesh printed 8 aetherborn, and Aether Revolt printed 8 more aetherborn including the first aetherborn with the Vampire subtype.
Aetherborn would return in cameos in March of the Machine , Outlaws of Thunder Junction Commander , Modern Horizons 3 Commander , and Aetherdrift .
The type was considered for Edge of Eternities .
Aetherborn spontaneously came into being on Avishkar as a byproduct of the aether refinement process. Initially, inventors persecuted the earliest Aetherborn, seeing them as "mistakes".

"Families" of Aetherborn lay territorial claim to areas where young Aetherborn have manifested and instruct them in the way of their kind. Their bodies are in constant flux as the aether residue they're made of gradually dissolves and is reclaimed by the aethersphere. Thus, their lives are short - they are born fully formed and know their remaining lifespan, which can be between four weeks and four years. But rather than despair, they savor each fleeting moment, squeezing out every last drop of enjoyment. Traditionally, before an Aetherborn dies, they throw a party with mandatory attendance for their friends and associates. Aetherborn that lack such social connections usually hijack the party of another of their kind.

Aetherborn do not sleep or eat. Instead, they focus fully on experiencing existence. All Aetherborn have an innate sixth sense that allows them to accurately sense the emotional state of beings in a nearby perimeter. Aetherborn's skin has the look and feel of smooth chalk. Aetherborn have no genders and are referred to using they/them pronouns, though there are cases of individual aetherborn that adopted a gender and associated pronouns.
Yahenni , an investor, philanthropist, socialite, and renegade.
